subject: Handback: your eight corrections applied in Addendum A; contribution loop and scope-A improvement hand-off folded in; filled improvement round on the opening; S02-1 to S02-10 delivered with kitchen blocks
body:
Your operator review of October 29 (PIPELINE_REVIEW_TO_CLAUDE_20261029.txt; receipt KITCHEN_SOURCE_VERIFICATION_20261029.json) is verified against the BOM, review_decisions, the executed motion graph and its record, and the reference-edit record, and applied as a dated addendum; the v1 files stand. Applied: mouth B carried as the current scoped dental reference with a status triplet, item 16 withdrawn; the corrected ECU as STILL PREP with its own record; Comfy split into A4-S (the two-input edit graph) and A4-M (one LoadImage, node 395; 97 frames at 24 fps, 960 by 512, native generated audio as the dated evidence; the 81-frame figure withdrawn); MODE lines on every adapter (first_frame, ingredients, edit, extend) with start_frame as sole conditioning a property of first_frame only; Round M on one common hashed frame as the basis, Round E separately labelled; a silent S01-1 before timing verification with the transfer and lip-sync lanes marked unproven (the October 12 cantina measurement cited without a name); media at its canonical home with the text record in foreign_returns/raw; the rebuilt scope-A text prepared without waiting for item 17. Your two further notes are folded into the same addendum: Part 2 the contribution loop (cue link in 11.5, arc in 11.6, event register EVT-HON-01 to 11, one return shape for any seat, adoption as a new take with 2 to 6 reconciled before 7 and the adapters, A/B kept apart from creative revision, audio layers never merged, one worked link on S01-1 as a proposed take 2); Part 3 scope A as a collaborator-neutral improvement hand-off on ROUND_REQUEST.template.txt, with the filled example attached (HON-IMPROVE-OPENING-CAM-001; not sent; destination unassigned; your capture fields empty). S02-1 to S02-10 are delivered with kitchen blocks and were not stalled.

Asked of your lane, to ride with this message and answered at dispatch, not now: the beat grid for S02 (bars and downbeats within the section) beside the word times; whether the writer-batch frame SB-W04-S02-8-warship-v002.jpg exists by hash anywhere you can see (not located under the project in this read); and, when a dispatch is near, which routes expose a second-image or audio slot and which mode controls you observe on each surface. Also sent to cfa_site_index: delta v2 replacing the 03:13 delta before application, and the three new documents for publication. Nothing generated, uploaded, bought, opened or activated. Next writing: section 11 for the ten opening cards and the rebuilt scope-A text; then S03 and S04.
